sloka: उच्छाद्य स्नापयन्ति स्म नदीतीरेषु वल्गुषु ।अप्येकमेकं पुरुषं प्रमदा: सप्त चाष्ट च ॥ २.९१.५२॥
transliteration: ucchādya snāpayanti sma nadītīreṣu valguṣu ।apyekamekaṁ puruṣaṁ pramadā: sapta cāṣṭa ca ॥ 2.91.52॥

translations.english: 'O wine drinkers, drink as much as you can those who are hungry partake payasam and sacred meat'.
